te: Forces of the Holy Roman Empire and Electorate of Saxony are defeated by the Swedes at the Battle of Chemnitz, ending t…
dz: 三十年战争：神圣罗马帝国和萨克森选帝侯的军队在开姆尼茨战役中被瑞典人击败，结束了撒克逊军队在战争剩余时间的军事效力，并允许瑞典人进军波西米亚。
de: Thirty Years' War: Forces of the Holy Roman Empire and Electorate of Saxony are defeated by the Swedes at the Battle of Chemnitz, ending the military effectiveness of the Saxon army for the rest of the war and allowing the Swedes to advance into Bohemia.
